title: Lesson 7: Installing and Deploying Hermes Agent: Local Setup, Profiles, Gateway, First Run
description: The consultant's deployment discipline: how to stand up an agent correctly once you have the go-ahead. Isolation per engagement, a verified first run before you layer on features, and a gateway that turns a laptop experiment into an always-on tool your client actually uses.
